tasks.title: PRIMARY KEY should not change the query result.

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: PK与可空列条件折叠造成溢出行为差异，官方也用BIGINT核对；完整单行输入可测试优化一致性。

test_spec.setup: 分别创建带PK与不带PK的t0(c0 CHAR(1))并插1，sql_generate_invisible_primary_key=OFF；另BIGINT对照。
test_spec.steps: 对两表SELECT * WHERE -(~(c0 IS NULL))，记录1690错误/结果和警告。
test_spec.oracle: 同实际非空数据的表达式在两路径应有一致数值/溢出处理；避免把PK禁止NULL本身当错误。
test_spec.target_applicability: 8.0支持该类型、位反和常量折叠，输入完整而目标实际行为待查。

show variables like 'sql_generate_invisible_primary_key'; -- OFF

comments.author: MySQL Verification Team
comments.text:
Hi Mr. Jove,

Thank you very much for your bug report.

We do not think that your report is a bug. It is simply because you are using a column type from the CHAR domain, to which you can not apply all the operators that you used.

However, we have replaced your CHAR column type with BIGINT and got 100 % the same result.

That is why this report has become a verified bug.
